finalText:
The bug was in `engine.js` rounding after each discount step instead of only at the end. When stacking a percent and flat discount, the intermediate rounding (lines 24 and 27) lost precision that compounded when converting to currencies like GBP or JPY.

For example: `2x$9.99` with 10% off becomes `$17.982`, which rounded to `$17.98`, losing `$0.002`. When converted to GBP at 0.78, that lost penny becomes a whole cent in the final total.

Removed the intermediate rounding from the discount steps. Now all calculations stay in full precision until the final rounding after currency conversion. All 40 tests pass.
